legal_clauses.assignability_clause: This Assignment of Contract may be assigned by Assignee to any third party without the consent of Assignor or Seller.
legal_clauses.indemnification: Assignor and Seller shall indemnify and hold harmless Assignee from any claims, damages, or expenses arising from any breach of their respective obligations under this Assignment of Contract.
legal_clauses.governing_law: This Assignment of Contract shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.
legal_clauses.dispute_resolution: Any disputes arising from this Assignment of Contract shall be resolved through binding arbitration in accordance with the rules of the American Arbitration Association.
legal_clauses.closing_obligations: Assignee shall be responsible for ensuring that the property is conveyed to them free and clear of all liens and encumbrances at closing.
